record: San Jose Historic Resources Inventory survey sheets for Trinity Episcopal Church
facts: 1863 redwood Carpenter Gothic church, enlarged and turned to North Second Street in 1876. The building later gained a corner bell tower and spire.

record: National Register St. James Square district inventory
facts: Trinity Church occupies the south side of the square. Board-and-batten milled redwood siding is a defining material.
Dedicated in 1863, oldest church in continuous use in San Jose. Carpenter Gothic architecture and stained glass remain defining details.
